recommendations: Use std::chrono::steady_clock timestamps at exact outer boundaries; collect durations in memory and write outside measured window to minimize observer overhead. Store DeviceManager frame ID plus benchmark frame ID captured before Sample::finishFrame increments it; record rendered=true/false to exclude idle/invisible iterations.

A generic Donut end-of-frame callback or outer-loop elapsed callback avoids a Donut-to-Rtxpt header dependency; callbacks beforeFrame plus afterPresent alone omit GC and cannot measure exact full loop.
Preserve normal three-buffer pipeline, current settings, CPU/GPU overlap, native fence wait and Present behavior. Do not insert per-frame waitForIdle, fences, FPS limits or sleeps.

Use unmeasured trailing frames: target strictly beyond last measured frame359, preferably a few tail frames, so target-frame forced query drain/screenshot/exit stays outside120..359 and all240 measured outer loops return.
Report direct wall elapsed and elapsed/N throughput frame time; do not add CPU elapsed and GPU timestamp durations, since they overlap. Retain GPU scopes only as explanatory breakdown.

Describe the measured quantity as normal full main-loop wall time including CPU execution and natural GPU/present waits. It is not isolated end-to-end GPU completion latency of the same submitted frame.
